g.text: LT24 · 21 OCT 2026 · ENGINEERING COMPARISON · NOT FOR FABRICATION

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203e49

g.text: The 50 J example is NOT an established locomotive impact requirement.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203e49

g.text: LT23’s assumed 4 kN/mm law reaches 20 kN at 5 mm and stores 50 J. It does not establish dissipated energy.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203e49

g.text: ACE TA37-16 comparison: 33 mm mounting height; 16 mm nominal stroke; expansion envelope up to Ø48 mm.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203e49

g.text: The published dynamic curve applies above 0.5 m/s local impact speed. Low-speed and held-load curves are required.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203e49

g.text: Miner GBA-4 comparison: 33.3 mm free / 18.3 mm solid height; Ø48 mm expanded. Numerical curve remains required.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203e49

g.text: Mounting a taller bumper changes contact timing unless the pedestal or recess changes. No mount is frozen here.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203e49

g.text: Ineffective-bumper probe: 2.89 kN steel-stop reaction; 7.04 kN maximum rebound reaction across new cases.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #b95035

g.text: These are quasi-static reactions. Vertical impact velocity, effective mass, damping and rebound-catch shock remain unknown.
